No loaded source substantiates any specific pre-harvest ET threshold, seasonal water-use rate, or dormancy-regrowth operational claim for alfalfa in any Arab-region climate. rejection_reasons.reason: The article recommends fall irrigation through November in Arab-region context, citing a Nebraska-source observation about deep water storage. No loaded document provides a comparable fall-irrigation prescription for any of the 22 target Arab countries. The month November corresponds to the Northern Hemisphere mid-latitudes; climatic seasonality in Gulf, Sahelian, and Mediterranean Arab countries differs substantially, making direct transfer unsupported.
